crossRefs.note: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.
All the relatives of the poor shun him: how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they…
The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.
Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his…
The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the channel of brooks that pass away;
“He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.

translations.web: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.
translations.bsb: Wealth attracts many friends, but a poor man is deserted by his friend.
translations.kjv: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
translations.asv: Wealth addeth many friends; But the poor is separated from his friend.
